strings.subtitle: — Ntogelo ya Faili —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Kuvuta hakupatikana. Tumia kitufe cha chini.
strings.shred_button: T O G E L A
strings.ssd_warning: Tahadhari! Kwa SSD, njia hii haihaqikishi utogelelwaji kwa sababu ya TRIM. Programu hii ni ya HDD tu.
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS njia mbadala za data (ADS) hazijafanywa.
• Jarida la USN halijasafishwa.
• Nakala za kivuli na usawazishaji wa wingu
  (OneDrive na nyingine) haziathiriwi.
strings.status_full: Maudhui yote yalibadilishwa na sifuri. Haiwezi kurudishwa — zana zitaona sifuri tu.
strings.status_fast: Kichwa, mkia na mistari ya 4 MB ilibadilishwa. Kilichobaki hakijaguswa, lakini kwa sababu ya mapengo, faili haiwezi kurudishwa kikamilifu. Kwa nyaraka za siri tumia hali KAMILI.
strings.status_empty: Faili ilikuwa tupu, kubadilisha hakukuhitajika. Ilitogelwa.
strings.error_permission: Cannot access the file. It may be open in another program. Close it and try again.
strings.error_not_found: File not found. It may have already been deleted.
strings.error_is_symlink: This is a symbolic link. Links cannot be destroyed — the target file will remain intact.
strings.error_reparse: This is a placeholder file (OneDrive or similar). Its data is stored in the cloud, not on disk — nothing to destroy here.
strings.error_not_file: This is not a file (a folder or something else). Drop a file.
strings.error_hardlinks: This file has other hard links ({n} total). Hard links have no primary — all names are equal. If you destroy via current path, the data will be overwritten and truncated to 32 bytes, but the stub will remain accessible via other links. Delete all links first.
strings.error_compressed:
File is compressed, encrypted or sparse. Zero overwrite does not guarantee destruction of old data because NTFS stores it differently.

Remove the attribute: right-click → Properties → Advanced → uncheck 'Compress' and/or 'Encrypt'. Then run SHREDDER again.
strings.queue_confirm_text:
{count} files will be destroyed.
Total size: {size}.

Check the list before continuing.
This action is irreversible.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Remove all {count} files from the queue?

The files themselves will NOT be touched — only the list.
strings.hardlink_text:
File "{name}" has other hard links ({nlink} total).

Data will be destroyed for all names.
But stubs (32 bytes) will remain under other names in the folder.

You may need to delete these stubs manually.
strings.hardlink_apply_all: Apply to all hard links in queue
